description: This Swift source file defines the 'GeneralSettings' view component for a macOS application using SwiftUI. It manages various user-configurable settings, displays system status, gateway information, health metrics, and provides controls for remote gateway testing and logs. The file interacts with external modules for networking, device management, and system control.

classes.name: GeneralSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that presents various system and application settings, status indicators, and controls related to the OpenClaw application, including gateway management, health status, remote connection setup, and user preferences.

methods.name: refreshGatewayStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the current status of the system gateway environment and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: testRemote
methods.description: Performs a test of the remote gateway connection, updating the remoteStatus state based on the result.

methods.name: revealLogs
methods.description: Opens the log file viewer to display recent application logs, or shows an alert if logs are unavailable.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Sets the preferred gateway based on discovery and applies remote selection support.
